chunks: That its minimum is a khimār (headscarf) or something similar to it.

key_terms.الْخِمَارُ: a khimār; a headscarf used here as the minimum example of the gift
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; an impersonal transmission formula indicating a reported narration
key_terms.شِبْهُهُ: something similar to it in kind or value

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum parting gift for a woman in this divorce ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum amount for the parting gift is a khimār (headscarf) or something comparable to it. It serves as a concise fiqh ruling concerning post-divorce financial provision in this chapter's legal context.
